# Shared-state conflicts

**Not applicable.** There is no shared database or multi-writer store. The one persistent store, the IndexedDB save, has a single writer, enforced by a Web Lock per browser profile (`src/main.ts:159-161`), and its writes are serialised on one promise chain (`src/main.ts:98`). Inside the engine, all state is owned by one `GameEngine` instance. [HIGH]
